Dear Ms. Quinn,

Receiving your dispute regarding the account ACC-981334, we acknowledge your claim that you have already paid the debt. We take all disputes seriously and will investigate this matter in accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Florida state law.

Our records indicate that the original creditor for this account is Lakeshore Utilities. As per our records, the current balance due on this account is $342.31. We have no record of any payments being made on this account.

We understand that you have been receiving collection calls regarding this account. We will immediately cease all collection activities on this account, as per your request, until this dispute is resolved. We will also investigate the frequency and manner of our communication with you to ensure that we are in compliance with the FDCPA.

Please note that our investigation may take some time, and we will provide you with an update on the status of this account once it is complete. If our investigation confirms that you have indeed paid the debt, we will take necessary steps to update our records and close the account.

You have the right to further dispute this account if you believe that our investigation does not accurately reflect the status of the account. If you wish to continue disputing this account, please respond to this letter within 30 days.

Sincerely,

Continental Receivables Corp.
